APPROVE
`AnswersOnlyConstants` is now a single ternary dispatch, far below 15. The extracted helpers keep the same conditions and short-circuit order: the only additions are a redundant `k > 0` guard and a shared empty `noLocals` set in place of fresh empty sets. The diff introduces nothing that should break the build, though I reviewed only the diff and did not compile it, run tests, or check the hidden lines for name collisions.
